_note: Expansion 4.2 thermal. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Every item marked VERIFY is an assumption from docs/fw_4_2_thermal.md section 5. Path specs: {key, rel} -> path_for(key)/rel, {exp, rel} -> expansion folder. Change freely.

clearings._schema: Polygon layer, EPSG:6346, columns clearing_id (unique), clearing_type (landing|corridor|field_edge|other), optional age_band. VERIFY. The annotated non-pad disturbance layer name is not confirmed (framework section 14)

audit_blocks._schema: CSV with column block_id ('bx_by' 375 m ids). Optional. Sites in these blocks are excluded from matching and fitting

folds._schema: CSV block_id, fold (from the 3.0 scorer transfer_blocks.csv). VERIFY. Without it T4 refuses unless --fallback-folds

t0_routes._note: gas leaves near ground temperature, no temperature term at ordinary rates (framework T0)

sensors.name: landsat_tirs
sensors._verify: Native 100 m, delivered 30 m, ST_B10 scale 0.00341802 and offset 149.0 K from the Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 guide. Not yet read. VERIFY

sensors.name: ecostress
sensors._verify: About 70 m (LP DAAC ECO2LSTE.002 guide, not yet read). VERIFY

_scene_index_schema: CSV scene_id, sensor, datetime_utc (ISO), path (GeoTIFF, LST band per sensor config), cloud_frac (0-1 over the block), qc_pass (bool), optional lst_err_K
_tiepoints_schema: CSV scene_id, dx_m, dy_m (scene minus lidar edge position, metres)

gate._delta_T_note: User decision, proposed default 1.0 K (framework section 3). Fix before T1
gate._proxy_note: Pad minus matched clearing surface difference before dilution. null means not yet measured. The gate then reports only the break-even dT = delta_T / median fill

contrast._sign_note: Preregistered sign of pad minus clearing. +1 means pads warmer. User decision

added_value._delta_gain_note: User decision. Placeholder 0.05 recall at K
